caption:
Nobody can guarantee a visa approval. Here is what we do guarantee.

The decision belongs to the consulate. No agent changes that, and anyone promising otherwise is lying to you.

What we control is everything before the decision: a complete file, documents that agree, the right consulate, and every predictable objection answered in advance. And if we miss the appointment window we agreed in writing, you get a full refund.

alt: What Visa Doctor can and cannot promise UAE residents

slides.headline: NOBODY CAN GUARANTEE AN APPROVAL.
slides.sub: Anyone who says otherwise is lying.
slides.note: The decision belongs to the consulate. No agency, no fee and no promise changes that.

slides.headline: THE PROMISE TO WALK AWAY FROM
slides.never: "Guaranteed approval" or "100% success, pay now." Nobody can commit to a decision they do not make. A promise like that tells you exactly how the rest of the relationship will go.
slides.instead: A written scope of what we will do, a clear timeframe for the appointment, and a refund if we miss it. Promises about our work, not theirs.

slides.headline: WE ACTUALLY CONTROL
items: Whether your documents agree with each other
Whether predictable objections are answered in advance

slides.answer: APPOINTMENT IN THE AGREED TIME, OR FULL REFUND.
slides.body: That is a promise about work we control — not about a decision we do not.
slides.note: Narrow on purpose. A guarantee you can actually hold us to.

slides.headline: A LICENSED DUBAI DOCUMENTATION AGENCY
slides.body: We are not an embassy, a consulate, VFS Global or BLS International. We prepare and organise documentation. Approval, processing time, entries and validity are decided solely by the relevant consulate.
slides.source: Office 311, Stadium Point, Dubai Sports City
slides.takeaway: You may also apply directly through the official centre.

slides.headline: SEND ONE MESSAGE. WE DO THE REST.
